title: Stormwind City and Harbor

closeups.name: The gate and the Trade District

notes: Stormwind's streets and harbour are WMO 21138 (file 7962574, 289 groups; the harbour is group 282 = WMOAreaTable 144226, wmoGroupId 84873, z 2..234) at (-8931.6, 539.3, 102.0), yaw 38.5. Its streets stand 20-25 yd over the terrain (Trade District floor 96-100, terrain 72-75), so the lattice's leveling under them walks blind through buildings and over the harbour cliff (the KNOWN SHARED BUG): inside the city the routes are walked on the WMO's own floor (floorCity, fids = the city WMO only). The two terrain stretches are lattice legs: the gate bridge onto the Valley of Heroes street (floor meets terrain at (-9070, 416), 93.1 vs 92.9), and the quay from the harbour ramp's foot ((-8573, 1110), floor 18.3 = terrain 18.3) over the sw_harbor_* stairs and piers (walkways: their own floor layers) to the boat. A full gate-to-boat walk = leg A + city route F + leg B.
